review_text: I simply stopped by to purchase a creme brulee latte to go, but I was impressed by how friendly the staff was. The ambiance, the coffee, and the decor are all quite wonderful. All of the snacks and beverages were delectable and excellent. This location is fantastic! They treated their customers with the utmost respect. The internet connection is unlimited and really fast. Yes, this location is ideal for both learning and unwinding. It had air conditioning and was extremely peaceful. This coffee shop would be the finest if you're searching for a spot to unwind and read some books or whatever. Everything I needed was given to me, therefore there was nothing more I could have asked for. Good work, guys! Keep making excellent pastries and coffee! They will undoubtedly receive a five-star rating from me for everything they offered. absolutely amazing You guys are awesome, thank you! Added a video for reference:)

Along Rasay St. sits this two-storey building you won’t miss. Menu is intriguingly abundant of coffee and non-coffee drinks, wraps, pastas, pica’s, burgers, croffles and rice bowls. Takeaway of Creamy Spinach Quesadilla was surprisingly novel. Creme Brulee Latte was a bit too sweet though. Hoping to dine in soon for a change.
Food is so good and cheap! Worth trying everything on the menu! Been visiting the place often for their delicious food and coffee! Visit them now. ❤️
